# KeyLeak

> Local evidence collection and remediation verification for security agents.

Start with `keyleak capabilities --json` for the installed version's supported checks,
skill routes, network requirements, registered patterns and coverage limitations.
Pattern matches and correlations are not proof of exploitation. Inspect validation
status and incomplete coverage before making a release decision.

## Skills
- [Audit planning](.codex/skills/keyleak-audit/SKILL.md): Discover checks and preview a defensive audit.
- [Local review](.codex/skills/keyleak-local-review/SKILL.md): Secrets, Python serialization, archive evidence and repository hygiene.
- [Agent assets](.codex/skills/keyleak-agent-assets/SKILL.md): Credential checks for skills, agent rules and MCP settings.
- [Report triage](.codex/skills/keyleak-report-triage/SKILL.md): Review redacted evidence, suppressions, coverage and remediation.

## Documentation
- [Setup and usage](README.md)
- [Flow audit and ecosystem survey](docs/AGENT_INTEGRATION_AUDIT.md)

Skills are distributed in the repository and require an approved CLI installation.
This index is not proof of installation, marketplace listing, or search indexing.
